messages.subject: Project Ironvale - SPA (Buyer's response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Our response attached. We've met you part-way: de minimis £40k, aggregate basket £400k, warranty notice period 21 months. We've accepted the 2-year covenant. The W&I recourse structure (Sellers' cap of £1 for non-fundamentals) is unchanged and is a deal point for us. I think we're close.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

James - those numbers work for the Sellers (£40k / £400k / 21 months, 2-year covenant). We accept the W&I recourse structure. I think we have an agreed SPA subject to disclosure. Let's aim to sign w/c 8 December and complete on the 12th.

Rachel
